name: ... and a Batch of Ooze
summary: Chemist Fuely asks you to test slime samples from Un'Goro Crater. He needs five of the pure samples you find.

sections.title: Testing the Samples
sections.body: The Testing Equipment beside Chemist Fuely in Undercity can show which Un'Goro Slime Samples are pure. You gather samples from slimes in Un'Goro Crater, then use the equipment to test them. Fuely needs five Pure Un'Goro Samples, and their purity is what matters.

faq.answer: Chemist Fuely needs five Pure Un'Goro Samples.

faq.q: Where do I get the slime samples?
faq.answer: You can gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from slimes in Un'Goro Crater.

faq.q: How do I find the pure samples?
faq.answer: Use the Testing Equipment beside Chemist Fuely in Undercity to see which samples are pure.
The Testing Equipment is beside Chemist Fuely in Undercity.
